technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with some bullish structure (Ichimoku, Supertrend) but price remains below all major moving averages with no confirmed reversal signals—high risk of continued downside.

fundamental.summary: AME shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 63 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling by junior member contradicted by extreme market fear (33 Fear/Greed score) creating contrarian buy opportunity; no news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinationals; earnings in 63 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 13.11, Stoch 5.13) with Ichimoku above cloud and Supertrend bullish create contrarian buy setup in fear-driven market (33 Fear/Greed), price near support 118.33 offers defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages (EMA 9/21/50/200) with no confirmed reversal signals, zero fundamental conviction, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), and earnings event risk in 63 days make this a trap-prone oversold bounce rather than sustainable entry.
